info.title: PostGIS API
info.description:
Proxy API for PostGIS databases. Layers, named queries and geometry operations are configured in the admin backend (/admin).

Authentication: API key in header `X-API-Key` (or `Authorization: ApiKey <key>`) or an OIDC access token (`Authorization: Bearer <token>`). Layers and queries flagged as public can be read anonymously.

Geometries are GeoJSON in EPSG:4326 unless `srid` is given.

get.summary: List all layers visible to the caller

get.description: Supports bbox, attribute filters, paging, sorting, property selection, re-projection and simplification.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Attribute filter column:op:value (repeatable, AND). Operators: eq, neq, lt, lte, gt, gte, like, ilike, in (comma separated values), isnull, notnull. Example: population:gt:10000

parameters.name: properties
parameters.description: Comma separated list of properties to return. Default: all exposed properties.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Max. number of features (capped by the layer's maxFeatures).

parameters.name: srid
parameters.description: SRID of the returned geometries. Default 4326.

parameters.name: precision
parameters.description: Number of decimal places of the coordinates. Default 6.

parameters.name: simplify
parameters.description: Simplify geometries with this tolerance (layer units).

post.summary: Insert a GeoJSON Feature or FeatureCollection (role write)

parameters.name: srid
parameters.description: SRID of the input geometries. Default 4326.

parameters.name: srid
parameters.description: SRID of the returned geometry. Default 4326.

put.summary: Update a feature (role write). Only supplied properties are changed; geometry if present.

parameters.name: srid

Execute a predefined query, parameters as query string (?name=value)

post.summary: Execute a predefined query, parameters as JSON object {"name": value}
Run a PostGIS function on GeoJSON input
post.description: Operations: transform, buffer, area, length, perimeter, distance, centroid, pointonsurface, envelope, convexhull, simplify, makevalid, isvalid, union, intersection, difference, intersects, contains, within, geometrytype, npoints. Measurements are in meters when geography=true.

parameters.name: connection
parameters.description: Connection to run the operation on. Default: settings.defaultConnection.

type.description: Point, LineString, Polygon, MultiPoint, MultiLineString, MultiPolygon, GeometryCollection

oneOf.description: Second geometry for distance, union, intersection, difference, intersects, contains, within.

srid.description: SRID of the input geometries. Default 4326.

targetSrid.description: SRID of the output geometry (transform: required). Default = srid.

tolerance.description: Tolerance for simplify (in units of srid).

geography.description: Measure on the spheroid in meters (area, length, perimeter, distance, buffer).

name.description: Parameter name, referenced as @name in the SQL.

type.description: string, integer, bigint, number, boolean, date, timestamp, uuid, json, geojson

QueryParameterConfig.description: A parameter of a named query.

geometry.description: Input geometry as GeoJSON geometry (or Feature).

srid.description: SRID of the input geometry. Default 4326.

relation.description: intersects, within, contains, touches, crosses, overlaps, disjoint, equals, dwithin

distance.description: Distance for dwithin (meters if geography=true, otherwise layer units).

geography.description: Compute dwithin on the spheroid in meters.

SpatialFilter.description: Spatial predicate against an input geometry.

ApiKey.description: API key created in the admin backend.
ApiKey.name: X-API-Key

Bearer.description: OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect access token (if OIDC is enabled).
